basePath.description: Subdirectory prefix for deployment. Set to empty string '' for domain root (e.g. artmaxstudio.ro/), '/template' for a subfolder, or '/repo-name' for GitHub Pages.

title.description: Main title of the portfolio/journal website

description.description: Meta description for search engines and social cards

categories.description: Portfolio category tags, display names, and neon glow colors in 3D WebGL space

id.description: Internal category identifier matching the CSV category column (e.g. video, 3d, ai, motion)

label.description: Human-readable label shown in the HUD filter buttons

color.description: Hex color code for the 3D ribbon curve and HUD neon glow (e.g. #ff003c)
